description: Six-panel TEM figure (a)–(f) of Fe–18Mn–10Al–xC low-density steels; every panel is a bright- or dark-field micrograph carrying an inset selected-area diffraction pattern (SADP) and a scale bar. (a) 0.5C steel, γ phase: smooth contrast cut by sharp straight bands, 0.2 µm bar, inset indexed 020, 111, 1̄11 with no extra reflections. (b) 0.5C steel, α phase: mottled, wavy dislocation-type contrast, 0.5 µm bar, inset indexed 121, 112, 011. (c) 0.8C steel, γ + κ: banded contrast with fine mottled regions, 0.2 µm bar, inset indexed 111, 200, 100, 111 — the 100-type superlattice spot marks an ordered phase. (d) 0.8C steel, twins in γ: dark lenticular/plate-like bands crossing the grain, 0.2 µm bar, inset an unlabelled many-beam spot pattern. (e) dark-field image of α phase, 0.8C steel, 0.5 µm bar: uniform field of very fine bright speckles; inset indexed 111, 222, 110α. (f) dark-field image of γ phase, 1.2C steel, 0.5 µm bar: fine bright speckle throughout; inset indexed 131, 220, 110, 111. Together the panels demonstrate that 0.5C is precipitate-free while 0.8C and 1.2C contain fine ordered phases in austenite and/or ferrite.

observations.observation: The group comprises six TEM micrographs (a)–(f), each with an inset SADP and a scale bar; (e) and (f) are dark-field images while (a)–(d) are bright-field images.
Scale bars are 0.2 µm in panels (a), (c) and (d) and 0.5 µm in panels (b), (e) and (f).
Panel (a) inset SADP reflections are labelled 020, 111 and 1̄11; no extra reflections between the fundamental spots are distinguishable in this pattern.
Panel (b) inset SADP reflections are labelled 121, 112 and 011, over a mottled bright-field α-phase contrast.
Panel (c) inset SADP carries the labels 111, 200, 100 and 111, i.e. a 100-type superlattice reflection appears that is not labelled in panel (a) or (b).
The two dark-field panels (e) and (f) show uniform fields of very fine bright speckle, contrasting with the smooth/banded contrast of the bright-field panels (a) and (b).
The inset SADP in panel (d) shows a spot pattern but its individual reflections carry no index labels.
The caption states that (a)–(b) are the 0.5C steel (γ and α phases), (c)–(e) the 0.8C steel (γ + κ, twins in γ, dark-field of α) and (f) the dark-field image of γ in the 1.2C steel.
The citing text states that no precipitates exist in either the austenite (Fig. 2a) or the ferrite (Fig. 2b) of the 0.5C steel.

The citing text states that weak extra spots between the fundamental reflections in the SADPs of the 0.8C and 1.2C steels indicate the existence of precipitation particles, shown in Fig. 2(c), (e) and (f).
The citing text states that SADP indexing confirms the 0.8C steel contains a κ carbide phase [(Fe,Mn)3AlCx] in austenite (Fig. 2c) and B2 domains with fine DO3 particles in ferrite (Fig. 2e).
The citing text states that the 1.2C steel contains κ carbides in the austenite matrix (Fig. 2f).

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph of the γ phase in 0.5C steel. Smooth, almost featureless contrast crossed by straight sharp bands; scale bar 0.2 µm. Inset SADP indexed 020, 111 and 1̄11, with no extra spots between the fundamental reflections.
Bright-field TEM micrograph of the α (ferrite) phase in 0.5C steel. Mottled, wavy contrast with broad dark dislocation-type bands; scale bar 0.5 µm. Inset SADP indexed 121, 112 and 011.

Bright-field TEM micrograph of γ + κ in 0.8C steel. Banded contrast with fine mottled/lobed features; scale bar 0.2 µm. Inset SADP indexed 111, 200, 100 and 111, the 100-type reflection being an extra superlattice spot not present in (a).

Bright-field TEM micrograph showing twins in the γ phase of 0.8C steel: dark plate/lenticular bands with internal fringe-like contrast cutting a brighter matrix; scale bar 0.2 µm. Inset SADP is a spot pattern whose individual reflections are not labelled.
Dark-field TEM image of the α phase in 0.8C steel, showing a uniform field of very fine bright speckles against a darker background; scale bar 0.5 µm. Inset SADP indexed 111, 222 and 110α.

Dark-field TEM image of the γ phase in 1.2C steel, showing fine bright speckle distributed over the whole field with darker curving boundaries; scale bar 0.5 µm. Inset SADP indexed 131, 220, 110 and 111.
